records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three outbound emails (email:e79f849e, email:5245033d, email:719f64d6) and no tickets at all — no signal of engagement. Pro plan gives some purchase intent, so not negligible, but unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: One small first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project created is usually all it takes for things to click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm glad to walk through that first project with you on a 15-minute call this week -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
